[Setting: Background/Lighting] The lighting remains bright and even, casting soft shadows on the floor and within the pet's enclosure. (6) [People: Face/Hands] The man turns slightly toward the camera at the end, speaking directly while his hands rest on his knees. [Objects: Details/State] The puppy remains sitting calmly in its pen, looking toward the man. A green plant on a white stand is visible in the distant background. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The overall environment is quiet and domestic, with warm artificial light providing a cozy and informative atmosphere for the training vlog.
